definition.title: On-demand Design contracts
definition.purpose: Publish five owner-scoped entries with independent tool and knowledge lookup, direct saved-field delivery, and one submission for decided dependencies.

nodes.title: Design provider tools
nodes.objective: Design provides a five-line index of authorized entries. Responses sends a client loader, resolves exact selected schemas from the local publication and forwards correlated results on the stored chain. The native CLI retains its publication rules. Publish compact controls and execution envelopes; separate allowed research from per-turn activation. Keep tracking and historical turns off the initial wire.

nodes.title: Design operation discovery
nodes.objective: Design registry lookup excludes knowledge. Unique exact methods select one owner. Every clearly matched executable owner delivers complete ordinary arguments independently of discovery metadata, schema size and workflow scopes; alternatives summarize purpose and remain individually readable. Resource reads accept named fields and deliver saved media through the App conversation context. Execution accepts work and binds prior results. Expose scoped historical turns and full host constraints on demand. Validate every execution at the canonical Host. Publish executable scoped reads and guaranteed delivery fields from the selected owner. The request Host retains only a delivery selection rejected before dispatch and consumes its correction once under full admission. Every candidate carries its owner execution route. Recipe dependency metadata is computed and delivered only when requested on an exact read.

nodes.title: Design provider integration
nodes.objective: Independent registry enumeration checks every searchable action and registered tool against its actual input owner. Offline Responses capture checks the three recorded search menus, validates their ordinary arguments and applies both edits through Host and Core. Known operations still reuse one execute definition. Measure UTF-8 result bytes and exchanges. Exercise conditional web research, scoped history and compact cold requests through real provider preparation and scripted transport. Classify recorded submissions from their outer arguments and verify rectangle edits and a Dome delivery correction against actual provider receipts and Core mutations. Replay the partial Dome import query through published Responses and compare ordinary and recipe-authoring reads while preserving known edits and dependent ordering.

observations.summary: Recorded square replay measured 2,677 cold request bytes and 2,953 bytes loading search and execution at matched identifier lengths. Only selected schemas and current image pixels were submitted.
Recorded Dome candidates returned the actual Host route before the import. Ordinary reads of three actions measured 5,335 bytes; authoring returned the same inputs plus canonical wrappers.

Offline Responses imported the reference immediately after the partial search and returned original identity and pixels. Core applied both square edits. Dependent window creation and ordering remained in one invocation.
